full_page.content:
c. 1952, November 24.
The following is a faithful transcription of the typed draft of the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
CAPUCHIN FRANCISCAN FATHERS
ST. FELIX FRIARY HUNTINGTON, INDIANA
November 24th, American Thanks-Gifing Day; Deo Gratias.
Rev. Thomas G. Brennan. Rosary Academy Bay City, Michigan.
My Dear Father Brennan:
God bless you and yours. I do hope that you are well these days and that our dear Lord guide you always. For as years and decades pass we realize more and more clearly, with Holy Jobe that, "The life of man on earth is a warfare". Indeed a warfare it is that, notwithstanding the innumerable graces and safe-guards that surround us, is fraught with pitfalls and dangers at every turn. How can we ever appreciate as we ought, or be grateful for having from infancy been blessed with the supernatural certainty that the True Faith alon can inspire and insure? ! Deo gratias a billion.
I have been wanting to write you these several weeks and especially since Sr. M.C. was down a couple weeks ago. I know you are interested in her welfare and that, like many of the rest of us, have been trying to help her find her bearings and the peace of soul she seems temporarly at least rather sadly to have lost sight of. However, I feel that if we can just keep our heads and, especially if she can only be induced to have patience and to humbly foster confidence in God; I am sure, as I have been trying to assure her right along, that Almighty God is permitting all this trouble of hers - seemingly a real "night of her soul", to come as a blessing in disguise - as a feature of her preparation "sine qua non", of her arriving at that peace the world knows nothing about; the peace of soul she once most probably dreamed of but, of which, for her vocational maturity she has been permitted seemingly to lost sight these years and sadly to have forgotten. . True, she has made innumerable mistakes and stupid blunders. Who has not made them? Nevertheless and notwithstanding all such and even were they multiplied.
(Unfinished)
